notes: NEW MENUS: new main menu (Multiplayer, Settings, News) and a new lobby with a team roster
LOBBY: the big PLAY button picks the online mode - left/right or D-pad to change it, A or click to start
CUSTOM: private code matches and solo games vs bots (any mode, map, bots, time limit) live under CUSTOM
SCORESTREAKS: pick 3 of 6 (UAV, Supply Drop, Body Armor, Mortar Strike, Advanced UAV, Airstrike); earn them with kills, use them with X or D-pad up
ACCOUNT: set your callsign in Settings > Account
NEWS: every patch listed on the main menu
KILL SOUND: punchier kill confirm, higher pitched on headshots
SIGHTS: see-through rear apertures and slimmer front posts, open-frame reflex, one dot in red dots, clearer glass on every optic
